prompt: can you grade this task 2 essay and tell me what band it's roughly at? [technology-complexity essay, see evals.json for full text]

assertions.text: Gives a per-criterion band breakdown naming all four official criteria (Task Response, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range & Accuracy)

Identifies at least 3 of the real planted errors (statment, comunicate, thier, stressfull, dificult, 'technology also bring' subject-verb agreement, 'has introduce' wrong participle, effect/affect confusion, 'more easier' double comparative)
Does NOT penalize the essay for using simple/repeated vocabulary as if that alone were a Lexical Resource weakness (per the channel's real 33.5%-common-words finding)
Checks whether the introduction's stated position matches the conclusion's stated position
Gives at least one concrete rewritten sentence/example, not just abstract comments
